executions.name: The Old Way
executions.script: Beast form. The pack-ghosts of every wolf he has ever led circle with him — then the screen is all fur and red. He stands at the center, human again, wiping his mouth with a king's economy. He always eats first; he never eats alone.

executions.name: Wishbone
executions.script: One paw on each shoulder, jaws taking the collar. A single shake — the bone-cam shows cervical, and the wide shot completes the thought against the broken moon: make a wish.

desecration.name: Short Leash
desecration.script: The low lope simply doesn't stop at the bell — a red streak exits frame, one boot left standing.

overdrive.name: THE HUNT REMEMBERS
overdrive.script: The lights die to moonlight. Three strobe-lit passes, and on the fourth he is simply behind them, resetting his cuffs like a king after a hunt.
